name: Chelsea Green
profileSummary: Chelsea Anne Cardona is a Canadian professional wrestler. As of January 2023, she is signed to WWE, where she performs on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Chelsea Green and is the leader of The Green Regime stable. She is a former two-time and inaugural WWE Women's United States Champion. She also makes appearances for WWE's partner promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), where she is a former one time AAA World Mixed Tag Team Champion with Ethan Page. She is a former one-time WWE Women's Tag Team Champion.
